Bug_Title: Consumed Stream pipelines should not be reused
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the showBug method where a Stream pipeline is consumed after the first terminal operation, and then attempted to be used again in the second terminal operation. This will yield unexpected results.
Trigger_Explanation: The bug is triggered when the consumed stream pipeline is reused. In the test case, the assertNotEquals method is used to compare the results of two terminal operations on the same stream pipeline, which is not allowed as per the rule 'Consumed Stream pipelines should not be reused'.
